source_doc.title: Nabtesco official — Precision Reduction Gears (market share statement)

sources.quote: We have an approximately 60% (Nabtesco's estimate) share of the global market for precision reduction gears when it comes to the joints of medium-size to large industrial robots.
The reduction gears serve to provide excellent acceleration capabilities, smooth motion, low backlash, and accurate positioning precision, leading to enhanced robot controllability.
